steps.name: Taran Refugee
steps.text: No, run! They're over here, too!

steps.name: Taran Refugee
steps.text: Bloody hell... They've got this whole open part surrounded, don't they?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Erk...

steps.name: Special Forces Soldier
steps.text: Freeze.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: Okay, okay, I—I will... Bit too close with your saber there... You won't slip or anything, right?

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: R-Reed, help us! What do we do?!

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Against this many... it'll be hard to force our way out.

steps.name: Taran Refugee
steps.text: Huff... huh...? Did they just break my cudgel in half?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: ...They're acting very confident—

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: They don't want to seize us violently. They just want to quell the resistance we put up.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oof, not half bad, this lot...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I don't get it. How'd they follow us out to here? Where'd they come from...?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: —Wait, that one. I've seen him before.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: A couple days ago, when we ran into the spectre force...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Which means you lot aren't County Trent. These refugees are outside your jurisdiction. You've got no authority to arrest them.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: We'll have to take off our gloves here, if you're not goin' to follow the rules.

steps.name: Special Forces Captain
steps.text: The rules? That goes for you too. I see your piledriver spear missing its shells. You shouldn't be in a mile of the battlefield, soldier.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: It's not like this was meant to be a battlefield, was it?! They've not even put the campfire out...

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: —Watch out!
A black dagger slides forward without a sound. Its tip reflects not even the slightest bit of light, instead drawing a path of smoke.
The dagger points intimidatingly at Bagpipe's throat, though its bearer gives it no glance; his eyes have been focused squarely on Reed.
Reed can tell clearly, from his sharp glare, that he and the army are out for her here.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Isn't your pike meant to be burning with flames?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I suggest you drop the futile resistance. Make the smart choice, lay your weapons down, and hear me out.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I have nothing against the Tarans, let alone any plans to retaliate against civilians. And as for steering the masses clear of ruin, you and I should be united on that front.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Here's the official paperwork.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: What? A City Council writ of investigation?
The former Victorian soldier sets her weapon down.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Per the Council of the County of Trent's decision, I am here to investigate an overlooked, puzzling aspect of the arson cases.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: ...I—have no other choice, correct?

steps.name: Young Taran Refugee
steps.text: *sniffle*... *sob*...

steps.name: Soldier on Guard
steps.text: —What are you doing? Quiet down.

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (Agh, this is terrible.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (Always thought I should at least get my will in order, you know, before I finally meet my maker...)

steps.name: Taran Refugee
steps.text: (If you ask me? Should've written it up long ago.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (I did right after we first made it out, but I tore it up, I've been so happy these past two days. Really regret that now.)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (Oh, shut up, Fionn. We're not done for yet.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (They've got us all tied up and gagged, and everything we had to fight with got taken away. What else are we gonna do other than wait to die?)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (Sigh... Interrogation. Terrifying word. How many Tarans do we know made it alive out of an interrogation?)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (And who knows what they're prying out of a woman as kind as Reed.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (We all know each other, like family we are, but we don't know Reed from a bar of soap. Don't know where she came from, don't know what she was doing before.)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (What, is she an enemy to you now?!)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (No, no, no, that's not what I meant... I just...)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (*sigh* Selmon. You can't just make someone not be afraid to die.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (We can still see the fire from here. How long's it been since we last had the light of fire on a cold dark night?)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (Really thought I managed to escape, I did.)

steps.name: Taran Refugee
steps.text: (You even came about borrowing some stuff to rustle up some money. Didn't I say I'd make you some smoked fowl to sell?)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (Enough. We need to think of something. Figure this situation out.)

steps.name: Fionn
steps.text: (What? Figure this out? And what good is it gonna do us?)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (...I'm fed up of this, that's all.)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (I hate listening to how much you just sigh. Squatting about in the Taran quarter, passing by village threshing floors... it's just sighs everywhere. I'm sick of it.)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (Enough. Save it. Don't ask me how. You've always managed to find a way out.)

steps.name: Selmon
steps.text: (I'll draw the attention of those guards. Whatever you're going to do, figure it out yourself.)

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: You can ease yourself a little, 'Reed.' We're just having an ordinary chat.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: We have a warm fire, and we can hear the fowls chirp in the night. Surely you'd agree, this is a much more comfortable environment for conversation than a full-fledged interrogation room would be.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: No comment? That's your choice. I won't give you trouble for it.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Perhaps the nearby barracks' disrespect has given you cause for alarm. Allow me to apologize in their stead.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: Are you... here to investigate Dublinn? None of the people here have anything to do with them...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: You needn't explain. As you'd expect, I already have a good grasp of the situation.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: A singular attack has indeed spurred a minor region's barracks to take undue action against approximately a dozen Tarans, going so far as to accuse them of being part of 'Dublinn insurrectionist forces'.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: But in the company of all else contained in this very, very heavy dossier, their mistakes aren't worthy of mention. Of course, your situation is a little different compared to anyone else's...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: ...But I believe I can do something to help you break free of these troubles.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: After all, no stretch of your escape can have been easy.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: If... it wasn't for such harsh decrees, they would never have needed to run.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: No, please. This is a chat between the two of us, and I'm hoping you'll tell me about yourself. About the escape you began long prior to this one.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: ...I don't understand what you're talking about.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I'm asking you—

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: About your past identity.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: There are no records of any kind on you. No medical records, no nomadic city immigration records, no tax records, nothing.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: ...We Tarans are driven out wherever we go. It's not strange—that you don't see me in Victoria's records.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Then what about the unrest in County Hillock last autumn? Were you there?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: And what about the County Peninsula attack last May?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: I'm asking you and you alone.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Madam, if one does not tell anyone their birth name, where they are from, or who they are...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Wouldn't you say... they're just like a 'shadow?'

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Chenchen, I reckon you've already figured out who these men are?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Yeah. The ones that just fought us are no normal soldiers. Interrogating on the spot is very unique for procedure, too.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Plus, their leader knows quite a lot. That's why he's so courteous toward us... and me in particular.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right. I was just thinkin', they're lettin' us stand here and wait, only keepin' a couple men on watch, but the Tarans all have to have their hands bound. It's not fair...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Still, how'd he figure out who you are?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...I didn't expect the Intelligence Service to work this case.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: The Intelligence Service? Why would THEY be lookin' for Reed?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Her background must be an unusual one.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: And that's why she insisted on acting alone. She didn't want to drag anyone into the mess.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh, I've got a bad feelin' about this... Are they actually goin' to talk, you know, to a Taran? They won't rough her up, or threaten her into sayin' somethin' against her will, right?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Keep your voice down.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Mm... I remember what you wrote in your report on County Hillock.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Right. He's got his writ from City Council, he says he'll keep the peace and he has nothin' against Tarans, but...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: No. I should trust more. He's still an arm of City Council. He's not here to mess things up.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Most people can't withstand the pressure of interrogations, though.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: ...Do you remember how we did things, back in school when we partnered up?

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Oh! Your hand signal. I do...

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I remember. That's the ones we communicated with, the time we snatched those hazardous Originium products.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Good thing you remember.

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: It doesn't matter what Reed's background is. If she ends up as someone's pawn, that's going to send ripples through the status quo.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Yeah, and it'll be a nightmare on her as well... I mean, she's always seemed like she's been—tryin' to shake herself of somethin'.

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: I hear you loud and clear, Chenchen. We'll bring her back to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Dearie, me... what pristinely clear tracks.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: It seems your opponent is extending you an invitation again.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Oh, please, less ridicule.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And unfortunately, I'm afraid 'invitation' is an overstatement this time. He doesn't even so much as care about what dance his guest intends on.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: We're making our positions plenty clear just by showing our faces.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: Dublinn will rescue poor Loughshinny, expose her identity... and in the end, testify as to where I really stand.

steps.name: Harmonie
steps.text: And he knows. I have to wade in... so the other Draco of Tara doesn't land in his Duke's hands, and lessen The Leader's influence as a Draco herself.

steps.name: 'The Brigadier'
steps.text: No matter. I shall wipe his ambitions clean.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: ...The fowlbeasts have stopped calling. Do you understand what that means?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: ...... (Shakes head)

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: That's fine. Why don't we start with accounts of your recent incidents?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: You haven't caused serious injury to anyone. Even the arson at the barracks resulted in no deaths nor casualties, with only some supplies lost to fire.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Most Tarans are driven by their hatred of the Victorians to commit graver crimes. Your methods, in contrast, have been very mild.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Some witnesses even attest how you tried to fend off the Dublinn soldiers.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Do you admit to all this?

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I can only admit—I by no means wish to harm others.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Good. I can believe that. You have a fair conscience in you.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Now, if we can turn our attention to the quietened fowlbeasts...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: ...It seems your Dublinn friends are here to save you.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: No... No.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I can't go back...

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Go back? Oh, you mean—back to your life as a shadow?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Back to the kind of life surrounded by smoldering corpses, where the ashes of the dead coat the city streets?

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: To someone blessed with a conscience, it must be a very painful life.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: But it so happens you have a chance right now. You can make your own decision.

steps.name: Fischer
steps.text: Accept our protection. Your past crimes will be looked into no further.

steps.name: Reed
steps.text: I will never!

a.text: She must run. Run from the watchful eyes of all.
But how far must she go before she's finally run away?

steps.name: Ch'en
steps.text: Now!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Aye!

steps.name: Bagpipe
steps.text: Sorry, but you'll want to try on my fortcracker for size again!
Brandishing her piledriver spear, Bagpipe's gaze is away from the tent. Behind her stands Ch'en, and Ch'en's eyes, however, widen for an instant.
With not a sound, the tent over the interrogation turns to ashes.
A beam of flames bolts through the dark night, to then immediately vanish without a trace.
